characters.name: Ahsoka Tano
characters.description: Former Jedi Padawan of Anakin Skywalker, left the Jedi Order, Force sensitive, independent warrior, fought in the Clone Wars
characters.description_variant: Former Jedi Padawan, left the Jedi Order, Force sensitive, independent warrior, fought in the Clone Wars
characters.variant_note: Removed 'of Anakin Skywalker' from 'Former Jedi Padawan of Anakin Skywalker'.
characters.classification_note: Disputed: the description says she left the Jedi Order and calls her an 'independent warrior', while an earlier version of the article's plotting code labeled her 'Jedi'; the current one leaves her 'Unaligned'. Neither label is chosen.

characters.name: Boba Fett
characters.description: Bounty hunter, clone of Jango Fett, no Force sensitivity, works for the highest bidder, Mandalorian armor
characters.description_variant: Bounty hunter, no Force sensitivity, works for the highest bidder, Mandalorian armor
characters.classification_note: 'Mandalorian armor' describes equipment, not creed membership, so Mandalorian is not assigned. The article's plotting code labels him 'Bounty hunter' (an earlier version said 'Mandalorian'). Era is editorial; the description gives none.

characters.name: Chewbacca
characters.description: Wookiee warrior, co-pilot of the Millennium Falcon, loyal companion of Han Solo, fought in the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War
characters.description_variant: Wookiee warrior, co-pilot of the Millennium Falcon, fought in the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War
characters.classification_note: The description is silent on the Force, so the status is unknown; the article counts him among the characters without the Force and labels him 'Rebellion'. Rebel Alliance is inferred from the Galactic Civil War and his partnership with Han Solo and is not stated.

characters.name: Count Dooku
characters.description: Sith apprentice, formerly a Jedi Master, trained by Yoda, leader of the Separatists, elegant duelist
characters.description_variant: Sith apprentice, formerly a Jedi Master, leader of the Separatists, elegant duelist
characters.classification_note: Force sensitivity is inferred from the Sith and Jedi Master titles. Era is editorial.

characters.name: Darth Vader
characters.description: Sith Lord, formerly Anakin Skywalker, fallen Jedi, serves the Emperor, father of Luke and Leia, mechanical suit, immense Force power
characters.description_variant: Sith Lord, formerly Anakin Skywalker, fallen Jedi, mechanical suit, immense Force power
characters.variant_note: Removed 'serves the Emperor', 'father of Luke and Leia'. Kept the identity alias 'formerly Anakin Skywalker'.
characters.classification_note: Empire comes from 'serves the Emperor'. Prequel era comes from 'formerly Anakin Skywalker, fallen Jedi'; his earlier Jedi Order membership is not listed as a current allegiance.

characters.name: Din Djarin
characters.description: Mandalorian bounty hunter, no Force sensitivity, foundling, protector of Grogu, follows the Mandalorian creed
characters.description_variant: Mandalorian bounty hunter, no Force sensitivity, foundling, follows the Mandalorian creed
characters.classification_note: Mandalorian comes from 'follows the Mandalorian creed'. Era is editorial.

characters.name: Emperor Palpatine
characters.description: Sith Master, ruler of the Galactic Empire, manipulator, immense dark side power, orchestrated the Clone Wars
characters.description_variant: Sith Master, ruler of the Galactic Empire, manipulator, immense dark side power, orchestrated the Clone Wars
characters.variant_note: Unchanged: the description names no other person.
characters.classification_note: Force sensitivity is inferred from 'immense dark side power'. Sequel era comes from Rey's description ('granddaughter of Palpatine').

characters.name: Han Solo
characters.description: Smuggler, captain of the Millennium Falcon, no Force sensitivity, pragmatic, allied with the Rebellion, close friend of Chewbacca
characters.description_variant: Smuggler, captain of the Millennium Falcon, no Force sensitivity, pragmatic, allied with the Rebellion
characters.classification_note: 'No Force sensitivity' is stated. Sequel era comes from Kylo Ren's description naming him as a parent. The article's plotting code labels him 'Rebellion' (an earlier version said 'Neutral').

characters.name: Kylo Ren
characters.description: Dark side Force user, son of Han Solo and Leia Organa, formerly Ben Solo, trained by Luke then Snoke, conflicted
characters.description_variant: Dark side Force user, formerly Ben Solo, conflicted
characters.variant_note: Removed 'son of Han Solo and Leia Organa', 'trained by Luke then Snoke'. Kept the identity alias 'formerly Ben Solo'.
characters.classification_note: The description names no organization; 'dark side' is an alignment, not a faction. An earlier version of the article's plotting code labeled him 'Sith', which the description does not say; the current one leaves him 'Unaligned'.

characters.name: Leia Organa
characters.description: Princess of Alderaan, leader of the Rebellion, Force sensitive, twin sister of Luke, diplomat and military strategist
characters.description_variant: Princess of Alderaan, leader of the Rebellion, Force sensitive, diplomat and military strategist
characters.classification_note: An earlier version of the article's plotting code labeled her 'Jedi'; the current one says 'Rebellion'. The description never calls her a Jedi, so the Jedi Order is not assigned. Mentor comes from Rey's 'trained by Luke and Leia'.

characters.name: Luke Skywalker
characters.description: Jedi Knight, son of Anakin Skywalker, strong in the Force, hero of the Rebellion, trained by Obi-Wan and Yoda, redeemed his father
characters.description_variant: Jedi Knight, strong in the Force, hero of the Rebellion
characters.variant_note: Removed 'son of Anakin Skywalker', 'trained by Obi-Wan and Yoda', 'redeemed his father'.
characters.classification_note: Jedi and Rebellion come from the description. Mentor and sequel era come from other descriptions that say he trained Kylo Ren and Rey.

characters.name: Mace Windu
characters.description: Jedi Master, member of the Jedi Council, invented Vaapad lightsaber form, strong in the Force, confronted Palpatine
characters.description_variant: Jedi Master, member of the Jedi Council, invented Vaapad lightsaber form, strong in the Force
characters.classification_note: Leader comes from Jedi Council membership. Era is editorial.

characters.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
characters.description: Jedi Master, trained Anakin Skywalker, guardian of Luke, wise and disciplined, killed by Darth Vader on the Death Star
characters.description_variant: Jedi Master, wise and disciplined, killed on the Death Star
characters.variant_note: Removed 'trained Anakin Skywalker', 'guardian of Luke'; reduced 'killed by Darth Vader on the Death Star' to 'killed on the Death Star'.
characters.classification_note: The description does not state Force sensitivity; it is inferred from the 'Jedi Master' title.

characters.name: Rey
characters.description: Jedi, granddaughter of Palpatine, strong in the Force, scavenger from Jakku, trained by Luke and Leia, chose the Skywalker name
characters.description_variant: Jedi, strong in the Force, scavenger from Jakku
characters.variant_note: Removed 'granddaughter of Palpatine', 'trained by Luke and Leia', 'chose the Skywalker name'.
characters.classification_note: Jedi comes from the description. Era is editorial.

characters.name: Yoda
characters.description: Grand Master of the Jedi Order, 900 years old, immense Force wisdom, trained generations of Jedi, exiled on Dagobah
characters.description_variant: Grand Master of the Jedi Order, 900 years old, immense Force wisdom, trained generations of Jedi, exiled on Dagobah
characters.variant_note: Unchanged: 'trained generations of Jedi' names no individual.
characters.classification_note: Eras are editorial: Grand Master (prequel) and exile on Dagobah (original).
